title: The Cake with Walnuts
那塊核桃蛋糕
paras: Lena Fischer was the {{organizer|organizer}} of the Children's Hospital Foundation's yearly {{banquet|banquet}}, a dinner for two hundred guests. The old train station downtown made a lovely {{venue|venue}}, and the {{caterer|caterer}}, Mr. Okafor, had worked with her for three years. Everything was ready.
蓮娜．費雪是兒童醫院基金會年度晚宴的籌辦人，這場晚宴有兩百位賓客。市中心那座舊火車站是個很棒的場地，餐飲承辦人歐卡佛先生也已經跟她合作三年了。一切都準備好了。

At {{noon|noon}} on Friday, the day before the event, Mr. Okafor called. "Lena, I just read your final guest list. Twelve people have a nut {{allergy|allergy}}, and tomorrow's {{dessert|dessert}} is a walnut cake." Lena closed her eyes. The menu had been printed a month ago.
活動前一天，週五中午，歐卡佛先生打電話來。「蓮娜，我剛看完你最後的賓客名單。有十二個人對堅果過敏，而明天的甜點是核桃蛋糕。」蓮娜閉上眼睛。菜單一個月前就印好了。

"Don't worry," he said. "I can {{cater|cater}} to special diets, and I'll make a lemon tart for everyone. No extra charge." Then he added, "Come by at one. I'll feed your volunteers {{sandwich|sandwiches}} while they set up the tables."
「別擔心，」他說，「特殊飲食我都能照顧，我會替所有人改做檸檬塔，不加價。」接著他又說：「一點過來吧，志工們布置桌子的時候，我請他們吃三明治。」

The next night, the guests loved the tart. During the auction, a local bakery owner stood up and promised to {{donate|donate}} a thousand dollars to the children's ward, and others followed. By ten o'clock, this {{charitable|charitable}} evening had raised more money than any before it. Lena found Mr. Okafor in the kitchen and thanked him twice.
隔天晚上，賓客都很喜歡那款檸檬塔。拍賣時，一位當地烘焙坊老闆站起來，承諾捐一千美元給兒童病房，其他人也跟著響應。到了十點，這場慈善晚會籌到的款項比以往任何一場都多。蓮娜在廚房找到歐卡佛先生，向他道了兩次謝。
